findings: Placement is compact with no macro wall or density hotspot above0.7; pins are sparse and ordered on four faces.
Clock entry is centered on the actual sink centroid; a real CTS tree is not yet present.
Reset and two control drivers span too much of the leaf; buffer fanout caps did not remove the source-driver spread.
redesign: New local variant: six same-edge reset second stages plus compact reset-consumer bands; retained 16-bit serializer phase copies; private NR0 divider quotient-MSB copies for exponent and mantissa groups.
release: None: HOLD_ROUTE and DO_NOT_COUNT stay. No CTS, GRT, route or unchanged P&R retry.
